comments.body: Jog you masters aligns well and the PhD topic is of your interest, then just apply for the position with proper cover letter and CV. Having presented in a conference is always a plus. Sometime your past filed should be related to your masters or something related enough to proposed PhD position. If the ETH prof like your profile and invite for interview, he/she will definitely contact your references too. So also inform them. Plus do check the background of lab people and PI before applying for sanity check if the prof or his/her lab is good. You will also get to know them if invited for interview. Check for the red flags if any as 4 yrs of your life.
comments.author: Puzzleheaded_Run_312
